description: Targets and cost payment (prompt 17): the player chooses players first where Forge offers them (target: players) - Shock, Arc Trail with two targets, Gitaxian Probe on a player -, pays from the pool after Dark Ritual (mana.use), pays life for Phyrexian mana by tapping itself (Gitaxian Probe, Dismember) and answers Forge's decisions while a spell is cast (Kolaghan's Command's modes, Blaze's X, Burst Lightning's kicker, Village Rites' sacrifice). In German, like the app: its moments are the targeting and payment scenes of the game table's tests.
